purpose: Warn that a condition leads to an undesirable outcome.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vては / い-adjectiveくては / な-adjectiveでは / Nでは
If we leave now, it will be too early.
If it is this expensive, I cannot buy it every day.
With this number of people, we will not finish the work.
formation: Vては / い-adjectiveくては / な-adjectiveでは / Nでは
restrictions: Often followed by a negative judgment such as 困る, 無理だ, or できない.
mistake: Do not confuse conditional ては with repeated-action ては…ては.
